description:
[CLP mixture health & aquatic hazard additivity classifier. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Classifies chemical mixtures under Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 (CLP) applying additivity formulas for skin/eye corrosion and summation methods with M-factors for environmental aquatic toxicity.
Usage: Input mixture ingredients with concentration percentages and hazard classes to compute official GHS classifications and pictograms.
Returns: JSON object with { mixtureTradeName: string, isHazardousMixture: boolean, governingSignalWord: string, resultingGhsClassifications: array, requiredGhsPictograms: array, mandatoryPrecautionaryStatements: array }.

ingredients.description: Array of mixture raw materials and active ingredients

aquaticMFactor.description: Multiplying factor M for Acute 1 or Chronic 1 (default 1)

hazardClassification.description: CLP hazard classification of the raw substance

isAerosolOrSprayForm.description: Whether the product is dispensed as aerosol/spray

mixtureTradeName.description: Commercial mixture brand or trade name

name: clp_hazard_mixture_classifier
